clarifications_needed: size_band rooftop-count thresholds moved out of size_band per schema: auto-group segment qualifies at 10+ rooftops in BN territory (regional marketing clusters of 10–30); independent segment at 1–5 rooftops — encode via list-building filters; employee bands below are staffing-ratio estimates
Per-rooftop seasonal-decor budget vs. BN deal minimums is an open research gap — revenue proxies draw on NADA per-rooftop ad-spend averages ($543K/rooftop), not seasonal-display line items
Utah auto-group footprint is a confirmed gap — no Top-10 group has a validated UT presence; UT excluded from the group segment pending field validation
OEM co-op eligibility for physical seasonal lighting (30–100% reimbursement) is explicitly unvalidated — surface as a discovery-call question before any campaign referencing co-op
Foot-traffic-lift data for seasonal lighting at dealerships does not exist in the handbook — flag any ROI claim in campaign copy as untested

tech_signals: LinkedIn job postings for Regional Marketing Director or Director of Marketing at auto group
OEM facility-image program compliance (Mercedes Autohaus, BMW Retail.NEXT, Porsche Destination Porsche, Lexus L Studio) — signals premium-exterior-standards orientation
Preferred vendor program or MSA infrastructure visible in procurement job postings
intent_signals: Q3 budget planning cycle (July–September) — primary outreach window for year-end holiday installations
NADA Show attendance (February) — corporate marketing relationship building
Digital Dealer Conference attendance (September) — well-timed for Q4 planning conversations
New rooftop acquisitions or regional expansion announcements
OEM December campaign (Lexus December to Remember, Mercedes Winter Event, BMW Happier Holidays, Toyotathon) pre-season planning
exclusions: Single-rooftop or small-group operators (fewer than 10 locations) — route to independent segment
UT-only footprint (no validated Top-10 group presence)

tech_signals: OEM luxury/premium brand franchise (BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Lexus, Porsche, Audi, Cadillac) — higher OEM facility-image standards and budgets
Significant street frontage on high-traffic corridors (visible via mapping / street-view review)
Investments in landscaping, architectural signage, or showroom renovation visible on dealership website
intent_signals: Q3 outreach window (July–September) — dealer principals planning year-end traffic
Post-holiday strike follow-up (January–February) — permanent lot lighting and facade upsell window
New dealership construction or acquisition announcements in local business press
OEM December campaign season approaching (Lexus December to Remember, Mercedes Winter Event, BMW Happier Holidays)
Dealership advertising or social media showing current lot appearance during evening hours
exclusions: Non-luxury/volume-only franchises in low-visibility suburban locations
Dealerships in markets outside BN service territory
Dealerships with fewer than 100 vehicles on lot (below BN commercial install minimum — flag for discovery validation)
